The LCA practice complies with ISO 14040 standards and uses Argonne R&D GREET (Greenhouse gases, Regulated Emissions, and Energy use in Technologies) 2023 model as the life cycle database. The scope of this study covers the well-to- wheel (WTW) or well-to-pump (WTP) lifecycle, including the feedstock, conversion process, fuel storage and transportation, and combustion phases for locomotives. Notably, lifecycle emissions include contributions from the combustion phase. These emissions are calculated stoichiometrically based on the carbon and sulfur content of the alternative fuels. However, because testing data is limited for the combustion phase in Tier 4 locomotive, other CAPs—NO , and PM—are reported only for the WTP stage of the alternative fuel pathways.
